description: Gravity Project SDOH domain (GravityDomainEnum). Production writes EDUCATIONAL_ATTAINMENT for education and FINANCIAL_INSECURITY for income. The enum has 20 domains; the rows below are the ones these concepts use.

Inadequate financial resources to meet basic needs and maintain economic stability. Production uses it with Family income (the closest domain; income itself is not insecurity).

An individual's current relationship to the workforce. NOT used for Occupation: no Gravity domain describes occupation type, so leave category empty for Occupation until a domain is agreed (EMPLOYMENT_STATUS is about employment status, which the Occupation concept excludes). No concept in this guide uses this value yet.

The coded answer, from BaseObservationValueEnum (educational attainment + smoking status + occupation type values). Education level and Occupation use it. Write the BDC-HM value name (for example 8TH_GRADE_OR_LESS); the OMOP code in each row is its meaning. OccupationTypeEnum is the exception: HM defines its value names as OMOP CURIEs, so the CURIE is the name to write. Where production writes an OMOP meaning code for a named value, that is a known production departure pending Anne's decision. CHS production writes education into value_quantity.value_concept on an Observation instead; the BDC-HM place is value_enum on SdohObservation.

Mapping rule for Occupation: write a group only when the source category falls inside exactly one of the 23 groups. description: A Quantity. Family income uses it (data type decimal in the Concepts file): value_concept holds the bracket text, value_decimal an exact amount, unit {USD} in both cases (production writes 'USD').

Family income bracket as text, as production writes it (e.g. '$5,000 - $7,999', '< $5,000', '> $100,000'). Keep the cohort's own boundaries; brackets differ by cohort and year and must not be re-binned or inflation-adjusted. Do-not-know, no-response, refused and decline-to-answer codes are no value (production CARDIA writes 'No response' as a bracket; see questions). The range is BaseEnum and BDC-HM has no income bracket enum (see questions).
